name: EXP3 survivor: per-class w on LR text + id prior

text_model.features: word TfidfVectorizer(analyzer=word, ngram_range=(1,2), min_df=2, max_features=60000, sublinear_tf=True) + char TfidfVectorizer(analyzer=char_wb, ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=2, max_features=60000, sublinear_tf=True), hstacked
text_model.cleaning: URL -> ' URL ', @mention -> ' USER ', whitespace collapsed; no lowercasing, no stemming

id_prior.pool: training-fold ids/labels only (leak-free, asserted per fold)
id_prior.note: self-matches excluded; queries disjoint from the pool

duplicate_override: unanimous cleaned-text lookup, conflicting groups skipped
status: best validated config found by experiment_v2_*; NOT submitted (submission_2 requires an explicit request)
